name: CRASHTEST
detailed_description:
CRASHTEST is a fast-paced, parkour FPS game, set in a cyberpunk, neon, futuristic world. Run at high speeds, jump around, wall-run like a pro, wield futuristic guns and send bullets flying in every direction!

Hack into the neon-drenched world of ParadiseOS, and purge the system's antivirus. One slip-up and you will be forcefully disconnected. The only thing holding you back, is your skill, which will be crucial if you want to succeed.

A REALITY QUESTIONING SINGLE-PLAYER STORY CAMPAIGN

Experience a mind-bending single-player campaign where you play as a hacker breaking into the Oasis Corporation's sentient artificial intelligence powered metaverse ParadiseOS in an epic search for digital immortality. 

ENDLESS HOURS OF REPLAYABILITY

Designed to be highly replayable, enjoy a campaign that motivates you to push your skills to the fullest, and an addicting Wave Mode that encourages you to climb the leaderboards and compete with other players!

HIGH SPEED ADVANCED MOVEMENT SYSTEM

Experiment with a fast, smooth, and polished advanced movement system that allows you to wall-run, dash, and zoom across the arenas with ease and confidence!

BREATHTAKING RAY-TRACING VISUALS

Immerse yourself in CRASHTEST's vibrant and colorful world, which is built from the ground-up to take full advantage of ray-tracing! (Ray-tracing can be disabled for lower-end hardware)

JOIN MY DISCORD SERVER!

Would love to see you there!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or above
  • Processor: Intel 7th Generation CPU or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 620 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Additional Notes: 1080p / 60FPS / Potato Graphics Mode
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or above
  • Processor: Intel 10th Generation CPU or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA or AMD hardware Ray Tracing-capable GPU with 10GB dedicated VRAM or better (examples: NVIDIA RTX 3080 or better, AMD RX 6800 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Additional Notes: 1080p / 60 FPS / Ray Tracing Mode
